lesson.rainbow_weather.title: Rainbow Weather
lesson.rainbow_weather.summary: Build a roomy rainbow scene, add balanced clouds, choose your own weather details, then color three broad rainbow bands.
lesson.rainbow_weather.step.rainbow_arcs: Draw three big rainbow arcs together. Leave a comfortable space between each curved line.
lesson.rainbow_weather.help.rainbow_arcs: Start with the biggest arc, then let the next two curves sit inside it with breathing room.
lesson.rainbow_weather.complete.rainbow_: Your three curves now travel together like one rainbow.
lesson.rainbow_weather.step.clouds: Add one cloud on each side. Use slow rounded bumps and leave the rainbow easy to see.
lesson.rainbow_weather.help.clouds_hint: Keep each cloud simple and roomy. They do not need the same number of bumps.
lesson.rainbow_weather.complete.clouds: The clouds balance the rainbow from both sides.
lesson.rainbow_weather.step.weather_deta: Choose the weather story. Rain, sunshine and sparkles are only ideas—you can use one, mix them, or invent something else.
lesson.rainbow_weather.help.weather_deta: Look for open space in your scene and add only the weather marks you want.
lesson.rainbow_weather.complete.drawing: Your rainbow scene has its own kind of weather.
lesson.rainbow_weather.coloring.outer: Choose any color you like for the broad outer rainbow band.
lesson.rainbow_weather.coloring.middle: Now choose a color for the middle band. It can match your idea, not anyone else’s rainbow.
lesson.rainbow_weather.coloring.inner: Finish with the inner band and make the palette feel like yours.
